prose: In a Face the Nation interview, Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar fields CBS polling showing 50% of Americans think AI will create more problems than it solves and 45% want government restrictions. His answer: the burden is on the tech industry to show real benefits - job growth and prosperity, not travel scheduling - and he rejects the 'no guardrails' framing while arguing an unseen force drives the safety narrative, which he describes as a millenarian doomsday cult.

The wide-ranging transcript also covers the Iran school strike and AI targeting, the DOD dropping Anthropic, AI liability, and effective altruism - Sankar defending Palantir's role at the intersection of AI and state power.
highlights: CBS polling: 50% say AI creates more problems than it solves; 45% want restrictions.
Sankar: industry must prove meaningful benefits - jobs and prosperity, not conveniences.
He describes the AI safety narrative as driven by a millenarian doomsday cult.
Also covered: Iran school strike and AI targeting, DOD dropping Anthropic, AI liability, effective altruism.
